question: Can proposal-provenance-aware extent stability prevent SAM from truncating an already complete full-frame target while preserving useful tile refinement?

selection.rule: For a full-frame proposal only, retain the proposal box when the SAM mask bounding box retains less than 80 percent of proposal area; keep SAM refinement unchanged for tiles and extent-stable full proposals.
selection.threshold_origin: Reuse the already frozen 0.8 part-to-whole containment threshold; no new numeric search.

claim_boundary: Door 12 and all three families are consumed; this is failure-driven Development attribution. A pass requires an untouched family and does not prove pixel-mask quality, source-independent generalization, raw-phone operation, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
